[[Vanquisher|Vanquish]] the [[Arbor Bay]]. 

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Clear the Arbor Bay on the [[Tarnished Coast]] of all enemies in [[hard mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 15,000 [[Experience]]
* 2,000 [[Gold]]
* 5,000 [[Asura rank|Asura reputation point]]s
* Complete the Base Objective for 250 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].

== Dialogues ==
=== Initial dialogue ===
; [[Zaishen Vanquish]]
: ''"Clear the Arbor Bay on the Tarnished Coast of all enemies in hard mode."''
